vb_textbox.text: In order to earn a high score you don't need to worry about the background but instead focus on the colours of the gnomes, the colour of the basket will also inpact the amount you'll get. the pairs of rhe gnomes all stay the same they may appear on opposit sides but they two colours will always be the same. the lighter forest tends to give you higher points so always select the colour gnome that will take you to the brighter forest.
